cohort: 153 pregnant women with one previous cesarean section, a singleton pregnancy, a fetus in the cephalic presentation with a medical indication for induction of labor and an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score less than 6)
finding: Cervical ripening with prostaglandin after previous cesarean delivery had a 56% success rate, with a 1.3% risk of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: Cervical ripening by prostaglandin after previous cesarean delivery has a 56 % success rate, with a 1.3 % risk of uterine rupture, especially when prostaglandin is combined with oxytocin.
